function.name: requests_get
function.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL to retrieve weather data from the Open-Meteo API. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: URL of the Open-Meteo API endpoint.

headers.description: Headers to include in the request. Each key-value pair represents a header field and its value.

Content-Type.description: The MIME type of the body of the request (used with POST and PUT requests).

Accept.description: Media type(s) that is/are acceptable for the response.

timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up. This is a float type value.

params.description: Query parameters for the GET request.

latitude.description: Latitude of the location, positive for N and negative for S. This is a float type value.

longitude.description: Longitude of the location, positive for E and negative for W. This is a float type value.

elevation.description: Elevation in meters above sea level for the location. The default value represents no elevation downscaling.

auth.description: Authentication tuple for HTTP authentication, in the format (username, password).

cert.description: Path to the SSL client certificate file (.pem). A null value means no client certificate is used.

cookies.description: Dictionary of cookies to send with the request. Each key represents a cookie name.

proxies.description: Dictionary mapping protocol names to the URL of the proxy. Each key-value pair represents a protocol and its proxy URL.

stream.description: If True, the response should be streamed; otherwise, it should be downloaded immediately.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate.

message.content:
Below is a **starter‑kit** for a full‑stack Trucking TMS (Transportation Management System). It is intentionally lightweight so you can copy‑paste, run, and then extend it to your own needs. > **TL;DR** – > *Backend*: Python FastAPI + SQLAlchemy + PostgreSQL (or SQLite for dev). > *Frontend*: React (Create‑React‑App) – only a few pages to demo the API. > *Key features* (all in the repo): > 1. **Fleet & Driver Management** – CRUD for trucks & drivers. > 2. **Dispatch & Routing** – create a shipment, assign a truck, compute an optimal route (using OSRM or Google Maps). > 3. **Weather Integration** – pull current weather for a route segment via the Open‑Meteo API (the tool you provided). > 4. **Billing & Reporting** – simple invoice generation and CSV export. Feel free to drop the code into a new repo, run `docker compose up` (see the Dockerfile), and start hacking. --- ## 1. Project Layout ``` tms/ ├─ backend/ │ ├─ app/ │ │ ├─ __init__.py │ │ ├─ main.py # FastAPI entry point │ │ ├─ models.py # SQLAlchemy ORM models │ │ ├─ schemas.py # Pydantic schemas │ │ ├─ crud.py # DB helpers │ │ ├─ routes/ │ │ │ ├─ __init__.py │ │ │ ├─ fleet.py │ │ │ ├─ driver.py │ │ │ ├─ shipment.py │ │ │ ├─ billing.py │ │ ├─ utils/ │ │ │ ├─ routing.py # Route optimisation │ │ │ ├─ weather.py # Weather helper (uses the provided function) │ ├─ Dockerfile │ ├─ requirements.txt │ └─ alembic/ # DB migrations (optional) ├─ frontend/ │ ├─ src/ │ │ ├─ App.js │ │ ├─ api.js # Axios wrapper │ │ ├─ components/ │ │ │ ├─ FleetTable.js │ │ │ ├─ DriverTable.js │ │ │ ├─ ShipmentForm.js │ │ │ └─ ... │ ├─ package.json │ └─ public/ ├─ docker-compose.yml └─ README.md ``` --- ## 2. Backend – FastAPI ### 2.1 `requirements.txt` ```text fastapi==0.111.0 uvicorn[standard]==0.30.1 sqlalchemy==2.0.30 psycopg2-binary==2.9.9 pydantic==2.7.4 python-dotenv==1.0.1 httpx==0.27.0 ``` ### 2.2 `app/main.py` ```python from fastapi import FastAPI, Depends from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware from . import routes from .models import Base, engine from sqlalchemy.orm import Session import os # Create tables on startup Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine) app = FastAPI(title="Trucking TMS") # CORS for local dev app.add_middleware( CORSMiddleware, allow_origins=["*"], allow_credentials=True, allow_methods=["*"], allow_headers=["*"], ) # Dependency: DB session def get_db(): db = Session(bind=engine) try: yield db finally: db.close() # Include routers app.include_router(routes.fleet.router, prefix="/fleet", tags=["fleet"]) app.include_router(routes.driver.router, prefix="/driver", tags=["driver"]) app.include_router(routes.shipment.router, prefix="/shipment", tags=["shipment"]) app.include_router(routes.billing.router, prefix="/billing", tags=["billing"]) ``` ### 2.3 `app/models.py` ```python from sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, String, Float, Boolean, ForeignKey, DateTime from sqlalchemy.orm import declarative_base, relationship from datetime import datetime Base = declarative_base() class Truck(Base): __tablename__ = "trucks" id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True) license_plate = Column(String, unique=True, nullable=False) make = Column(String) model = Column(String) year = Column(Integer) capacity_tons = Column(Float) is_active = Column(Boolean, default=True) created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow) class Driver(Base): __tablename__ = "drivers" id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True) name = Column(String, nullable=False) license_number = Column(String, unique=True, nullable=False) phone = Column(String) is_active = Column(Boolean, default=True) created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow) class Shipment(Base): __tablename__ = "shipments" id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True) origin_lat = Column(Float, nullable=False) origin_lon = Column(Float, nullable=False) dest_lat = Column(Float, nullable=False) dest_lon = Column(Float, nullable=False) weight_tons = Column(Float, nullable=False) truck_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey("trucks.id"), nullable=True) driver_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey("drivers.id"), nullable=True) status = Column(String, default="pending") # pending, dispatched, completed route = Column(String) # JSON string of waypoints created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow) class Invoice(Base): __tablename__ = "invoices" id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True) shipment_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey("shipments.id")) amount = Column(Float) issued_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow) ``` ### 2.4 `app/schemas.py` ```python from pydantic import BaseModel, Field from typing import Optional, List from datetime import datetime class TruckBase(BaseModel): license_plate: str make: Optional[str] = None model: Optional[str] = None year: Optional[int] = None capacity_tons: Optional[float] = None class TruckCreate(TruckBase): pass class TruckRead(TruckBase): id: int is_active: bool created_at: datetime class Config: orm_mode = True class DriverBase(BaseModel): name: str license_number: str phone: Optional[str] = None class DriverCreate(DriverBase): pass class DriverRead(DriverBase): id: int is_active: bool created_at: datetime class Config: orm_mode = True class ShipmentBase(BaseModel): origin_lat: float origin_lon: float dest_lat: float dest_lon: float weight_tons: float class ShipmentCreate(ShipmentBase): pass class ShipmentRead(ShipmentBase): id: int truck_id: Optional[int] driver_id: Optional[int] status: str route: Optional[str] created_at: datetime class Config: orm_mode = True class InvoiceBase(BaseModel): shipment_id: int amount: float class InvoiceCreate(InvoiceBase): pass class InvoiceRead(InvoiceBase): id: int issued_at: datetime class Config: orm_mode = True ``` ### 2.5 `app/crud.py` ```python from sqlalchemy.orm import Session from . import models, schemas # ---------- Trucks ---------- def create_truck(db: Session, truck: schemas.TruckCreate): db_truck = models.Truck(**truck.dict()) db.add(db_truck) db.commit() db.refresh(db_truck) return db_truck def get_truck(db: Session, truck_id: int): return db.query(models.Truck).filter(models.Truck.id == truck_id).first() def list_trucks(db: Session, skip: int = 0, limit: int = 100): return db.query(models.Truck).offset(skip).limit(limit).all() # ---------- Drivers ---------- def create_driver(db: Session, driver: schemas.DriverCreate): db_driver = models.Driver(**driver.dict()) db.add(db_driver) db.commit() db.refresh(db_driver) return db_driver def get_driver(db: Session, driver_id: int): return db.query(models.Driver).filter(models.Driver.id == driver_id).first() def list_drivers(db: Session, skip: int = 0, limit: int = 100): return db.query(models.Driver).offset(skip).limit(limit).all() # ---------- Shipments ---------- def create_shipment(db: Session, shipment: schemas.ShipmentCreate): db_shipment = models.Shipment(**shipment.dict()) db.add(db_shipment) db.commit() db.refresh(db_shipment) return db_shipment def get_shipment(db: Session, shipment_id: int): return db.query(models.Shipment).filter(models.Shipment.id == shipment_id).first() def list_shipments(db: Session, skip: int = 0, limit: int = 100): return db.query(models.Shipment).offset(skip).limit(limit).all() def update_shipment_status(db: Session, shipment_id: int, status: str): shipment = get_shipment(db, shipment_id) if shipment: shipment.status = status db.commit() db.refresh(shipment) return shipment # ---------- Invoices ---------- def create_invoice(db: Session, invoice: schemas.InvoiceCreate): db_invoice = models.Invoice(**invoice.dict()) db.add(db_invoice) db.commit() db.refresh(db_invoice) return db_invoice ``` ### 2.6 `app/routes/fleet.py` ```python from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, status from sqlalchemy.orm import Session from .. import crud, schemas from ..models import engine from ..main import get_db router = APIRouter() @router.post("/", response_model=schemas.TruckRead) def create_truck(truck: schemas.TruckCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db)): return crud.create_truck(db, truck) @router.get("/{truck_id}", response_model=schemas.TruckRead) def read_truck(truck_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db)): db_truck = crud.get_truck(db, truck_id) if db_truck is None: raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Truck not found") return db_truck @router.get("/", response_model=list[schemas.TruckRead]) def list_trucks(skip: int = 0, limit: int = 100, db: Session = Depends(get_db)): return crud.list_trucks(db, skip, limit) ``` ### 2.7 `app/routes/driver.py` ```python from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException from sqlalchemy.orm import Session from .. import crud, schemas from ..main import get_db router = APIRouter() @router.post("/", response_model=schemas.DriverRead) def create_driver(driver: schemas.DriverCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db)): return crud.create_driver(db, driver) @router.get("/{driver_id}", response_model=schemas.DriverRead) def read_driver(driver_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db)): db_driver = crud.get_driver(db, driver_id) if db_driver is None: raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Driver not found") return db_driver @router.get("/", response_model=list[schemas.DriverRead]) def list_drivers(skip: int = 0, limit: int = 100, db: Session = Depends(get_db)): return crud.list_drivers(db, skip, limit) ``` ### 2.8 `app/routes/shipment.py` ```python from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, status from sqlalchemy.orm import Session from .. import crud, schemas from ..utils.routing import compute_route from ..utils.weather import get_weather_for_coords from ..main import get_db router = APIRouter() @router.post("/", response_model=schemas.ShipmentRead) def create_shipment(shipment: schemas.ShipmentCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db)): db_shipment = crud.create_shipment(db, shipment) # Auto‑compute route route = compute_route( (shipment.origin_lat, shipment.origin_lon), (shipment.dest_lat, shipment.dest_lon) ) db_shipment.route = route db.commit() db.refresh(db_shipment) return db_shipment @router.get("/{shipment_id}", response_model=schemas.ShipmentRead) def read_shipment(shipment_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db)): db_shipment = crud.get_shipment(db, shipment_id) if db_shipment is None: raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Shipment not found") return db_shipment @router.patch("/{shipment_id}/status", status_code=status.HTTP_204_NO_CONTENT) def update_status(shipment_id: int, status: str, db: Session = Depends(get_db)): shipment = crud.update_shipment_status(db, shipment_id, status) if shipment is None: raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Shipment not found") return @router.get("/{shipment_id}/weather", response_model=dict) def shipment_weather(shipment_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db)): shipment = crud.get_shipment(db, shipment_id) if not shipment: raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Shipment not found") # Grab the first waypoint (origin) for demo lat, lon = shipment.origin_lat, shipment.origin_lon weather = get_weather_for_coords(lat, lon) return weather ``` ### 2.9 `app/routes/billing.py` ```python from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException from sqlalchemy.orm import Session from .. import crud, schemas from ..main import get_db router = APIRouter() @router.post("/", response_model=schemas.InvoiceRead) def create_invoice(invoice: schemas.InvoiceCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db)): # Basic validation: shipment must exist shipment = crud.get_shipment(db, invoice.shipment_id) if not shipment: raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Shipment not found") return crud.create_invoice(db, invoice) @router.get("/shipment/{shipment_id}", response_model=schemas.InvoiceRead) def get_invoice_by_shipment(shipment_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db)): invoice = db.query(models.Invoice).filter(models.Invoice.shipment_id == shipment_id).first() if not invoice: raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Invoice not found") return invoice ``` ### 2.10 `app/utils/routing.py` ```python """ Simple route calculation using OSRM (Open Source Routing Machine). For production you might want Google Maps, Mapbox, or a commercial API. """ import httpx import json OSRM_URL = "http://router.project-osrm.org/route/v1/driving" def compute_route(start: tuple[float, float], end: tuple[float, float]) -> str: """ Returns a JSON string of the route geometry (polyline) and summary. """ coords = f"{start[1]},{start[0]};{end[1]},{end[0]}" url = f"{OSRM_URL}/{coords}" params = {"overview": "full", "geometries": "geojson"} resp = httpx.get(url, params=params, timeout=10.0) resp.raise_for_status() data = resp.json() # Store only the geometry and distance/time route = { "distance_km": data["routes"][0]["distance"] / 1000, "duration_min": data["routes"][0]["duration"] / 60, "geometry": data["routes"][0]["geometry"], } return json.dumps(route) ``` ### 2.11 `app/utils/weather.py` ```python """ Wraps the provided `functions.requests_get` to fetch weather from Open‑Meteo. """ import json from typing import Dict from ..functions import requests_get # <-- the tool you gave us def get_weather_for_coords(lat: float, lon: float) -> Dict: """ Returns current weather for the given latitude/longitude. """ params = { "latitude": lat, "longitude": lon, "current_weather": True, } # The tool expects a dict of params; we pass the function directly. response = requests_get( url="https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast", params=params, timeout=5.0, ) # The tool returns whatever the HTTP client returns; we assume JSON. return response.json() ``` > **NOTE** – The `requests_get` tool is a *Python* function. > In a real deployment you would replace it with `httpx.get` or `requests.get`. > For the purpose of this demo, the tool is called directly. --- ## 3. Frontend – React (Create‑React‑App) > **Prerequisite**: Node 18+. ### 3.1 `frontend/package.json` ```json { "name": "tms-frontend", "version": "0.1.0", "private": true, "dependencies": { "axios": "^1.6.0", "react": "^18.3.0", "react-dom": "^18.3.0", "react-scripts": "5.0.1", "react-router-dom": "^6.22.0", "react-bootstrap": "^2.9.0", "bootstrap": "^5.3.2" }, "scripts": { "start": "react-scripts start", "build": "react-scripts build" } } ``` ### 3.2 `frontend/src/api.js` ```javascript import axios from 'axios'; const api = axios.create({ baseURL: 'http://localhost:8000', // FastAPI dev server }); export default api; ``` ### 3.3 `frontend/src/components/FleetTable.js` ```jsx import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react'; import api from '../api'; import { Table, Button } from 'react-bootstrap'; export default function FleetTable() { const [trucks, setTrucks] = useState([]); useEffect(() => { api.get('/fleet').then(r => setTrucks(r.data)); }, []); return (

Docker Compose ### 4.1 `docker-compose.yml` ```yaml version: "3.9" services: db: image: postgres:16 environment: POSTGRES_USER: tms_user POSTGRES_PASSWORD: tms_pass POSTGRES_DB: tms_db volumes: - pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data ports: - "5432:5432" backend: build: ./backend command: uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload depends_on: - db environment: DATABASE_URL: postgresql://tms_user:tms_pass@db:5432/tms_db ports: - "8000:8000" volumes: - ./backend:/app frontend: build: ./frontend command: npm start ports: - "3000:3000" volumes: - ./frontend:/app environment: CHOKIDAR_USEPOLLING: "true" volumes: pgdata: ``` ### 4.2 `backend/Dockerfile` ```dockerfile FROM python:3.12-slim WORKDIR /app COPY requirements.txt . RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt COPY . . CMD ["uvicorn", "app.main:app", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "8000"] ``` ### 4.3 `frontend/Dockerfile` ```dockerfile FROM node:20-alpine WORKDIR /app COPY package.json package-lock.json ./ RUN npm ci COPY . . CMD ["npm", "start"] ``` Run everything: ```bash docker compose up --build ``` Open: * Backend API docs: * Frontend demo: --- ## 5. How to Extend | Feature | Where to start | |---------|----------------| | **Authentication** | Add OAuth2 / JWT in `main.py` and protect routes. | | **Real‑time tracking** | Integrate WebSocket endpoint (`fastapi.WebSocket`) and push GPS updates. | | **Advanced routing** | Replace OSRM with Google Maps Directions API (needs API key). | | **Driver mobile app** | Build a React Native or Flutter app that consumes the same API. | | **Analytics dashboard** | Use Pandas + Plotly Dash or Grafana + Prometheus. | | **Unit tests** | `pytest` + `httpx.AsyncClient` for API tests. | | **CI/CD** | GitHub Actions: lint, test, build Docker images, deploy to Kubernetes. | --- ## 6. Quick Test Script (Python) ```python import requests # Create a truck truck = requests.post("http://localhost:8000/fleet/", json={ "license_plate": "ABC123", "make": "Volvo", "model": "FH16", "year": 2022, "capacity_tons": 25.0 }).json() # Create a driver driver = requests.post("http://localhost:8000/driver/", json={ "name": "John Doe", "license_number": "D1234567", "phone": "555-1234" }).json() # Create a shipment shipment = requests.post("http://localhost:8000/shipment/", json={ "origin_lat": 34.0522, "origin_lon": -118.2437, "dest_lat": 36.1699, "dest_lon": -115.1398, "weight_tons": 10.5 }).json() print("Shipment created:", shipment) ``` --- ## 7. Final Thoughts * **Security** – The demo is intentionally open‑ended. Add HTTPS, rate limiting, and proper auth before production. * **Scalability** – Use async endpoints (`async def`) and a connection pool for the DB. * **Observability** – Log with `loguru`, expose metrics via Prometheus, and trace with OpenTelemetry. Happy hacking! 🚚💨
